changes: Give each drive a name, like “Mitchell’s card 1”. ListenSync asks the first time you plug a new one in. The drive’s own name doesn’t change.
New History tab: see what was put on each drive and when it was removed, and what’s on each drive even when it’s unplugged.
“Previously copied” on covers, in My library and in each title’s details, so you can tell what you’ve already put on a drive.
Titles already on a drive from earlier versions are added to the history, with the date they were copied.
New setting: take the star off a title once it has been put on a drive.
“What’s new” after an update, and a list of all changes in Settings.
The window opens bigger, with more room for everything (including the player).
Downloads are listed in the order they’ll be done.
Selecting text in a box and letting go of the mouse outside no longer closes the window.
A “Show drive contents” button on the drive card. The screen is now called “Drive contents”.
The drive’s space shows how many titles of each type are on it.
An About window with the author and a link to the app’s page.
Sharper small icons in the Mac app.
The Mac app is approved by Apple: it opens without extra steps and updates itself from now on.
Concerts say what kind of recording they are and who recorded them, and Home shows one copy of each show.
Tidier titles for chapters, tracks and songs.
Each title uses its own word (episode, track, part) instead of “chapter”.
Music starts on High quality.
Lists leave out items with nothing to play.
Offensive titles aren’t featured while browsing; search still finds them.
High quality picks the better copy again for some titles.
Even spacing between the collection tabs.
Pages say “titles” instead of “books” where they include podcasts, shows, music and talks.
Lectures count as “Radio & talks” in the drive’s space.
New collections: Live Music (288,000 concerts), Lectures & Speeches, and Vintage Music (187,000 songs from old 78 rpm records).
Lists of titles load in seconds and are updated every week, with a setting for the very newest lists.
Smaller collection tabs, plainer names and quicker tips.
Covers show up more reliably.
Fixed repeated chapters on some titles and a blank page after closing Settings.
The sidebar shows the app’s icon.
An “All shows” choice in Old Time Radio.
Clearer wording on the Downloads and My library pages.
